entries.clue: Fog-bound African desert where orange sand meets the Atlantic
Young deer that walks trustingly with Alice until it recalls what she is
Steep-sided hill with a table-flat top, common across Arizona
Precious pool of coolness cast by a rock at noon
Rasp and rumble in your sleep until a partner decamps to the spare room
The wretched condition of lying awake hour after hour, night after night
Undersea schooling an hour shorter each day, which is exactly how it got its name
Night a child spends at a friend's house, giggling far too late
The world's largest hot desert, sprawling across northern Africa
Watered green pocket where the barren waste suddenly gives way
Woolly flock counted one by one by the hopelessly wakeful
Hour it stays at forever at the maddest tea-table, so the cups are never washed
Glorious gibberish of the sort Carroll is celebrated for, in verse and prose alike
